openQuestionsNew: CANDIDATE, NOT ATTACHED: a Paul Petriello was head men's golf coach at Keystone College, La Plume PA (about 15 miles from Scranton), from 1 Feb 2016 through at least the 2017-18 season. His bio describes him as 'an avid golfer in the local area'; a Penn State graduate (BA, Labor Management Relations) who did graduate study in Managed Health Care at Marywood University (Scranton); a pharma and biotech sales and management professional (Schering-Plough, Johnson & Johnson, King Specialty Pharmaceuticals, GlaxoSmithKline Biologics); founder of PJP Investments (2007-09); and a youth baseball and basketball coach (S3, S4). The surname is rare and the Scranton-area base and age fit Sharon's brother, but no page names his parents, wife or children, and other Petriello families live in the Dunmore/Moosic area. John: if this is your uncle Paul, the facts can be attached as written.
